title: Integrating physical chemistry and sustainability: an educational study of linear and non-linear adsorption isotherms using chitosan in wastewater remediation
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00960J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tanishka Chauhan, Santunu Barua, Alexandre H. Pinto
An educational experiment was developed to use chitosan to remove tartrazine from water. The linear and nonlinear versions of isotherms were used to derive the thermodynamics parameters. Correlations with Green Chemistry Principles were made.
